_comment: The panel shows only the tank with the seneye monitor. Its id must match the collector's --tank (left-blue); the live reading replaces latest/series. tolerance_c is null until the lab sets it.
_probes_comment: Display names for the DS18B20 probes on the ESP32 hubs (data/shore-temps.json), keyed by probe ID. Unlisted probes appear as 'Hub <letter> · <last 4 of ID>' (hub folder shore-temps-<letter> on Gannet); add their IDs here to name them. Readings are raw, uncalibrated.
